scientific_integrity: Proof of full Grothendieck-ring equality via blowup and finite-etale boundary scissors; independent program verifies exact finite certificates; review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth finite-field degree-five del Pezzo surfaces with geometrically snc pentagon boundary; no claim of all log K3 surfaces. Individual numerical point-count cases and boundary Picard basis are covered by prior literature. Specialist motivic-cluster literature may contain equivalent results; independence and historical firstness are not certified.
title: Motivic collapse of the four Frobenius types of pentagon-boundary degree-five del Pezzo surfaces
